WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bats,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM appearances a
  INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT 
  bats,
  count,
  count / SUM(count) OVER () as share,
  count / (SUM(count) OVER () / COUNT(*) OVER ()) as count_divided_by_avg
FROM grouped
